Existing receive receipt JSON retains all accepted old/new ref values and at most 16 replaced heads, including parked and no-pipeline pushes; inherit only when the old object equals the previous accepted new object. A layout pin for each schema number pins its lineage by layout; no step receipt is stored. A changed layout requires a new number. Open applies numbered forward steps in one transaction, preserving immutable IDs, receipts and grants; the full audit chain and head are verified before commit. A gap refuses read-only and names the source schema's upgrade release; newer schemas refuse. Older backups name their reader release. Each step has a previous-code fixture proving complete record reads and unknown-ID refusal; the release guard requires both. Its named coverage test must run and pass. Current-schema opens only verify; creation and maintenance stay distinct. A missing admin database is never created. |
